row.name: assets_serial_uq
row.where: "serial_number" IS NOT NULL AND "deleted_at" IS NULL

row.name: borrowing_lines_open_idx
row.where: returned_at IS NULL AND marked_lost_at IS NULL

row.name: assets_storage_requires_warehouse_check
row.value: "storage_id" IS NULL OR "warehouse_id" IS NOT NULL

row.name: borrowing_events_movement_check
row.value:
(event_type IN ('issued', 'returned', 'marked_lost') AND asset_movement_id IS NOT NULL)
				OR (event_type NOT IN ('issued', 'returned', 'marked_lost') AND asset_movement_id IS NULL)

row.name: borrowing_lines_condition_check
row.value: returned_condition IS NULL OR returned_condition IN ('good', 'damaged', 'incomplete')

row.name: borrowing_lines_due_after_issue_check
row.value: due_at IS NULL OR issued_at IS NULL OR due_at > issued_at

row.name: borrowing_lines_origin_storage_check
row.value: origin_storage_id IS NULL OR origin_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL

row.name: borrowings_guest_id_type_check
row.value: guest_id_type IS NULL OR guest_id_type IN ('ktp', 'sim', 'passport', 'other')

row.name: borrowings_borrower_identity_check
row.value:
(borrower_type = 'user' AND borrower_user_id IS NOT NULL AND borrower_customer_id IS NULL AND guest_name IS NULL AND guest_phone IS NULL AND guest_id_number IS NULL)
				OR (borrower_type = 'customer' AND borrower_customer_id IS NOT NULL AND borrower_user_id IS NULL AND guest_name IS NULL AND guest_phone IS NULL AND guest_id_number IS NULL)
				OR (borrower_type = 'guest' AND guest_name IS NOT NULL AND guest_phone IS NOT NULL AND guest_id_number IS NOT NULL AND borrower_user_id IS NULL AND borrower_customer_id IS NULL)
